title: Use Seedance 2.5 on Magnific to move the camera in 3D space for controlled…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 on Magnific to move the camera in 3D space for controlled camera motion  
Add up to 50 photos of a character to keep character appearance consistent across scenes  
Generate longer, smoother scenes by using Seedance 2.5 on Magnific  
Export/save your Seedance videos in high-definition 4K
